title: Turkish Stuffed Rice Dolma
description: A traditional Turkish dish, dolma is a flavorful rice and herb filling wrapped in grape leaves. This recipe serves a modern twist by using rice as the wrapping material.

ingredients.name: dolma
ingredients.notes: available in most international grocery stores

instructions: Rinse the rice and soak it in water for 30 minutes. Drain and set aside.
Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened.
Add the chopped parsley, chopped dill, cumin, paprika, and salt to the pan. Cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the cooked rice to the pan and stir to combine with the herb mixture.
Rinse the grape leaves and pat dry with a paper towel. Cut the leaves in half lengthwise.
To assemble the dolma, lay a grape leaf flat on a work surface, with the stem end facing you.
Place a tablespoon of the rice mixture in the center of the grape leaf.
Fold the stem end over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the leaf into a neat package.
Repeat with the remaining grape leaves and rice mixture.
Serve the dolma warm or at room temperature.
